note: Candidates reviewed for this update but not admitted, with the reason and the evidence that would reopen each.

entries.candidate: Advisum AI data centre (100 MW) with 900 MW battery storage on about 5 ha, Niederaichbach (Landkreis Landshut, former Isar 2 nuclear site area, Bavaria)
entries.reason: The primary record behind the 22 October lead is now identified: Bavarian Ministry of Economic Affairs press release 398/26 of 9 September 2026 (www.stmwi.bayern.de/presse/pressemeldungen/398-2026/, found through the ministry's news sitemap, not the robots-disallowed press-list pagination) welcomes the plans of the Munich investment company Advisum for a 100 MW data centre and a 900 MW battery storage plant on five hectares in Niederaichbach. This government record supports an announced project, but no plot is identified: the Niederaichbach Bauleitplanung page (FNP Deckblatt 6, B-Plan 'Isarau' for a different area) and the council agendas up to 20 October 2026 contain no Advisum or data-centre plan, so no sourced locator is available.
entries.reopen_condition: A Niederaichbach council decision, B-Plan or FNP notice, permit record or Advisum statement that delimits the 5 ha plot (Flurnummern or a plan with Geltungsbereich), then an official parcel or plan locator, while the 9 September 2026 observation is in window (until 3 December 2026) or with a newer dated record.

entries.candidate: IGNIS Energy Germany data centre (up to 300 MW connection) with about 100 MW battery storage 'Rechenzentrum am Abbachhof', Wenzenbach (Landkreis Regensburg)
entries.reason: The Wenzenbach Amtsblatt 07/2026 (www.wenzenbach.de/media/103887/amtsblatt-juli-2026.pdf) explains that IGNIS presented a project idea on 5 June 2026 next to the planned TenneT substation in search area C below the Abbachhof, and that the council took only a 'Kenntnisnahmebeschluss' on 23 June 2026; it states that no data centre has been approved, no planning law created and no concrete plans submitted, and that the project depends on TenneT's grid-capacity (Reifegrad) procedure. The issue's exact publication day is not printed (end of July 2026), its site plan is a schematic, and the September gazette and the municipal sitemap timed out. No in-window dated record identifies a project beyond an idea, and no locator is available.
entries.reopen_condition: A Wenzenbach B-Plan Aufstellungsbeschluss with Geltungsbereich, a TenneT grid-connection allocation or an IGNIS statement naming the project, dated within the window, plus an official parcel or plan locator.

entries.reason: The Neckarwestheim Bekanntmachungen page (captured 23 October 2026) lists the early public participation (§ 3 Abs. 1 BauGB) for the Bebauungsplan 'Rechenzentrum', published 30 March 2026, with plan documents filed under 'KI-Rechenzentrum'. The notice is outside the 85-day window, no later procedural step is listed, and the plan PDFs sit under paths disallowed by the site's robots.txt (*.pdf, /fileadmin/Dateien/), so the developer, plan area and parcels were not read.
entries.reopen_condition: A dated in-window step of the procedure (formal Offenlage, Satzungsbeschluss) or a developer statement on an HTML page or another robots-permitted host, naming the project and its plan area, then an official parcel locator.

entries.candidate: Microsoft NRW01 Campus Bergheim/Paffendorf (Rhein-Erft-Kreis): data centre with 297.4 MW emergency-power plant (Gemarkung Paffendorf, Flur 9, Flurstück 269)
entries.reason: The UVP portal (uvp-verbund.de, detail last changed 26 May 2026) carries the Bezirksregierung Köln notice of Microsoft Deutschland MCIO GmbH's BImSchG application, with early-start request, for a 297.4 MW emergency-power plant at 50126 Bergheim, Gemarkung Paffendorf, Flur 009, Flurstück 269; public inspection ran from 26 May to 25 June 2026. The notice is outside the window and no decision step is listed. www.bergheim.de and www.rhein-erft-kreis.de disallow ClaudeBot in robots.txt and were not accessed; the Bezirksregierung Köln host was unreachable. DataCenter-Insider (9 July 2026, news) reports a building permit for Bergheim, which is not a primary record.
entries.reopen_condition: An in-window Bezirksregierung Köln BImSchG decision or other dated primary record (Microsoft construction update, permit notice on a permitted host) for NRW01, then an NRW ALKIS locator for Paffendorf Flur 9 Flurstück 269.

entries.reason: Found while adding noris München Ost. entries.candidate: Cologix NNJ3 data center, 200 Webro Road, Parsippany-Troy Hills, Morris County, New Jersey (existing operations)
entries.reason: Cologix's NNJ3 page (live capture 23 October 2026, local cologix-nnj3-20261023.html) carries dateModified 2026-09-25 and present-tense operating statements (120K SQFT, site capacity 15.5MW, onsite JCP&L substation), but the date is not a reliable publication date. The production site was still serving pre-redesign versions after that day: the Internet Archive copy of the data-centers sitemap of 10 October 2026 (local ia-cologix-data-centers-sitemap-20261010163022.xml) lists NNJ3 at 2026-06-18 and NNJ2 at 2025-03-12; the archived NNJ2 page of 6 October 2026 still carries the 2025-03-12 version; archived TOR2, SV1 and DAL3 pages of 6 October 2026 carry versions from 2025 to January 2026 although the live sitemap dates their edits 22-24 September 2026; and the archived home page of 10 October 2026 still has the old site template. The 22-25 September dateModified values therefore look like pre-launch edit dates, and the new versions became public between 10 and 23 October 2026 on an undetermined day.
entries.reopen_condition: An archived copy, Cologix release or other dated source that fixes the day the current NNJ3 version became public (or a later dated version), plus the Morris County / NJ statewide parcel for 200 Webro Road.

entries.reopen_condition: A dated public version of the Columbus pages (bounded by archived copies) or a dated Cologix or City of Columbus record for the Scherers Court campus, plus the Franklin County parcels for 535-585 Scherers Court.

entries.candidate: Published Cologix records dated by page versions: JAX1 and JAX2 (22 September 2026), MTL8 (22 September 2026), VAN4 and the Ashburn ASH2 project (15 October 2026)
entries.reason: Quality note for review, not a change in this fragment. The Internet Archive copy of Cologix's data-centers sitemap of 10 October 2026 (local ia-cologix-data-centers-sitemap-20261010163022.xml) gives lastmods JAX2 2024-10-16, JAX1 2024-10-02, MTL8 2026-08-13, VAN4 2026-06-22 and ASH2 2026-05-11, and archived Cologix pages and the home page of 6-10 October 2026 still show the pre-redesign versions and template. The page versions used for these five published records (curated:cologix-jax2-jacksonville-spring-park-road:existing-operations, curated:cologix-jax1-jacksonville-west-church-street:existing-operations, curated:cologix-mtl8-montreal-frederick-banting:existing-operations, curated:cologix-van4-vancouver-west-cordova:existing-operations, curated:cologix-ashburn-beaumeade-circle-campus:ash2-current-construction) therefore seem to have become public only after 10 October 2026; their 22 September dates may predate publication (the 15 October dates may or may not). The statuses stay in the window either way, but the recorded publication and observation days may be too early.
entries.reopen_condition: A verifier or status-correction review that fixes the public-release day of the redesigned Cologix pages (for example from an archived copy between 10 and 23 October 2026) and corrects the observation dates if needed.
